main_text.p: pondětem interpellans, [illegible, ~18 letters] Tu, ait, ne obliuiscaris eorum quæ dicturus eras : &, Factum bene quod in memoriam revocasti : &, Quàm iuuat interdum sermones mutuos serere!&, Quod præterij : &, Celeriter tu quidem rem percepisti : &, Pridem expectabam an eodem mecum recideres : aliasq; huiusmodi occasiones loquendi captās, ne respirare quidem eos sinit, quibuscum loquitur. Ac postquā singuli sunt ab eo ita enecti, tum ad eos accedere non veretur, qui plures vna coierunt, eosque de rebus seriis agentes, in fugam vertere. Sed & ludos ac palæstras ingressus, vt ne tantum pue-[illegible, ~8 letters] ri addicat ioler efficere,

page.notes: The Greek marginal note at the top right is too faint to read reliably, so it is marked illegible. The last line of the column is only partly visible and is marked illegible. The Latin line at the bottom left is the visible end of a left-hand column; its beginning is not visible. The Greek column is only partly legible. Doubtful Greek readings are marked [?]. The sign Ϛ stands for a printed mark in the Greek text, not a letter; its exact form is uncertain. The Greek "ἐπι-λάθης" note is printed in the upper right margin. The "B" and "4" at the foot are read as signature and page number, which may be reversed in the printer's scheme.
